title: Telegram forwarding: an armed assistant-forwarding entry for a session that no longer exists logs 'session not found' and is not cleared
outcome: When a session armed for Telegram assistant forwarding (forward_next_assistant_message_session_ids) or holding a forwarding cursor is deleted, the relay drops that entry with a single clear log line. It does not error with 'session not found' on every poll. Forwarding for live sessions is unaffected.
acceptance: Telegram forwarding: an armed assistant-forwarding entry for a session that no longer exists logs 'session not found' and is not cleared is done
